purpose: Recover the 7 candidates lost to the transport failure (control arm) AND measure whether doubao-seed-2.1-lite can run this protocol at all (treatment arm). The two goals are deliberately separated because mixing them would make the score uninterpretable.
single_variable: model only — prompt, protocol, code, packets, attempts, throttle are identical across arms

arms.why: same model as the run that produced the existing 222 candidates, so its output is comparable and may be assembled with them

arms.authority: NEW — requires named authorization (gate-28 authorized a different model)
arms.prior_evidence: 22-doubao-lite-provider-ceiling-20261010: status=failed_protocol_and_signed_semantic_gate_route_closed, items attempts=0, relation 2/4 packets failed, signed_cases 37<40

probe_step_0.why: `.env` is rewritten by parallel sessions; an ark key 401'd on 2026-10-12. Config resolving is NOT the same as the endpoint working.

0b.command: STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_MODEL=... STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_BASE_URL=... STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_API_KEY=... uv run python probe_extraction_endpoint.py --arm control|treatment
0b.rule: the arm is chosen by the environment, never by a flag, so the probe cannot claim one model while calling another

probe_step_0.abort_rule: any arm whose 0b probe fails is aborted; no budget is spent on it

base: industrial-fulian-md char:5246-5537 (7 critical gold records lost to TransportOutcomeUnknown)
packets.note: B-1 must be ruled first: it decides whether this is 1 packet or 3

invariants.attempts_max: gate-28 execution_requirements — must not be relaxed
invariants.automatic_retries: >= 1 (the original loss was caused by automatic_retries=0)
invariants.input_isolation: no gold records, target ids or labels reach the model
invariants.output_location: new evidence directory; run-1/run-2/v6 artifacts byte-unchanged

exit_criteria: both arms' 0b probes pass, with endpoint and model recorded per arm
automatic retries enabled and repeated packet execution is idempotent
target packets produce candidates; artifacts land in a new directory and old ones are byte-identical
failures are recorded, never silent, and attributed to infrastructure | model behaviour | our contract signal
tools/check_freeze_chain.py and the assembler self-check stay exit 0
control-arm candidates enter assembly and scoring; treatment-arm candidates never do
if treatment-arm items attempts == 0, declare the model unusable here and stop spending
metrics are emitted per arm with the same metric set; no cross-arm merging
md and docx are reported separately
treatment_metrics: verbatim-quote reachability (does evidence_quote occur in the source segment)
out_of_scope: no change to gold, contract, thresholds or prompts (model is the only variable)
no relaxation of fail-closed; no response_format
no treatment output in this round's score
no human adjudication substituted by the agent
